scope_note: Audit evidence only. Not authorization to adopt, install, import, execute, or copy any candidate. Not scientific validation.
retrieval_method: GitHub REST API (repository metadata, commits, releases, license metadata) and public README/LICENSE text. No clone, install, import, execution, or dataset download.
release_revalidation_method: GitHub Releases latest endpoint and exact Git tag refs, checked 2026-10-22. Release tags are evidence snapshots, not install pins.
release_scope_note: The original head_sha and last_commit_utc fields retain the 2026-10-17 inventory snapshot. latest_release values below were revalidated separately on 2026-10-22 and do not imply compatibility with this repository.
license_scope_note: GitHub license labels and root LICENSE text describe repository-level declarations, not exhaustive package, transitive-dependency, or component licensing. Package metadata is recorded separately only where an authoritative package source declares it. None of these fields establishes security posture, maintenance quality, compatibility, legal clearance, or scientific validity.

candidates.license_spdx_or_text: Apache-2.0 (SDK); model and dataset terms are per-artifact and unverified
candidates.capability_evidence: README: clinical NER and HIPAA PII de-identification for clinical text; local Python, MLX, Android, and browser runtimes; 2,266 manifest entries. It is clinical NLP, not an EEG, BIDS, or signal library.
candidates.maintenance_signal: Active; pushed on access date; SECURITY.md present.
candidates.runtime_requirements: Python 3.10+; model artifacts downloaded from a model hub; optional MLX, Android, and browser runtimes.
candidates.security_privacy_notes: README states that model downloads, remote-provider adapters, and telemetry-enabled paths may use the network. The domain is clinical free text, which this repository does not ingest. Any use would involve PHI-like data.
candidates.disposition_rationale: No in-repo clinical free-text path exists. Adoption would add a clinical-NLP runtime with network model fetches and per-model terms, outside the EEG/forward-model/topology scope. HOLD status forbids clinical claims.
candidates.proof_test: If ever reconsidered: a synthetic free-text fixture proves the step is absent from the default pipeline and blocked without an explicit flag.

candidates.capability_evidence: README: rubric-centered research-plan generation; data-generation from arXiv TeX; rubric-conditioned OPSD and GRPO training; evaluation suite. Artifacts on Hugging Face under separate terms.

candidates.security_privacy_notes: Corpus derived from arXiv papers; per-artifact licensing on Hugging Face is unverified. No EEG data.
candidates.disposition_rationale: Research-agent workflow tool, not a scientific runtime. The rubric pattern is already captured. Training stack and artifacts are out of scope.
candidates.proof_test: Not applicable: reference only. The user-supplied lead ziu-real/papergym resolves to nothing; the canonical owner is ZJU-REAL.

candidates.capability_evidence: Repository description: reads and writes BIDS-compatible datasets with MNE-Python. In-repo adapters/mne_bids.py ingests explicit metadata and feature tables; it does not call the MNE-BIDS layout parser.
candidates.runtime_requirements: requirements-eeg.txt (mne-bids>=0.13); depends on MNE-Python.
candidates.security_privacy_notes: Reads local BIDS trees only if called. No network use in audited paths.
existing_overlap: external_tools/registry_seed.json (mne-bids, notes the layout reader is future work)
candidates.disposition_rationale: Best fit for the EEG/BIDS handling gap: a fuller MNE-BIDS layout reader behind the existing adapter, which is metadata-only today.
candidates.proof_test: Synthetic BIDS fixture: adapter reads layout and rejects malformed sidecars without network access.

candidates.capability_evidence: Repository description: benchmarks for BCI datasets. dataset_importers/moabb_importer.py maps dataset metadata only; it never calls get_data().
candidates.runtime_requirements: Optional dependency; fetching data is network-bound and must stay disabled.
candidates.security_privacy_notes: MOABB's get_data() downloads datasets. The importer must never call it. Dataset licenses are not exposed by MOABB's API.
candidates.disposition_rationale: Existing metadata importer covers the need. Protocol conformance validation is in flight in another PR, so this audit adds no code.

candidates.capability_evidence: Repository description: validator for the Brain Imaging Data Structure.

candidates.license_spdx_or_text: CeCILL-B (LICENSE.txt, read); BSD-like, GPL-compatible; not in this repository's license classifier
candidates.capability_evidence: README: C++ package solving EEG and MEG forward problems with BEM; Python bindings on PyPI and conda-forge; cites Gramfort et al. 2010.
candidates.maintenance_signal: Active; pushed 2026-10-13; tagged releases; CodeQL and CodeCov badges in README.
candidates.runtime_requirements: C++ build or prebuilt wheels; BLAS/LAPACK-class linear algebra.
candidates.security_privacy_notes: Native compiled code. Attribution duty under CeCILL-B. Installing a binary wheel is a supply-chain step.
existing_overlap: dual_engine/ (synthetic EEG forward-model contract in PR #388 in flight)
no import of openmeeg in repository code
candidates.disposition_rationale: Directly relevant to the forward-model need, and it is an established EEG/MEG forward solver. It can only sit behind an optional, bounded adapter after the license is reviewed, because the classifier does not recognize CeCILL-B.
candidates.proof_test: Synthetic sphere/BEM fixture: adapter output matches a fixed reference within tolerance, with no network and no installation at test time.
